versions.name: Camp Rainey Mountain

features.note: A barrier-free campsite with wheelchair-accessible tents, showers, and restrooms.
The H. Randolph Holder Dining Hall is air-conditioned.
The Stewart Amphitheatre is used for campfires and assemblies.
Centrally located shower houses with hot water.
A limited number of campsites have outlets for powering medical equipment.
Two chapels: a lakeside chapel and a chapel in the woods.
Launch, the camp's signature counsellor-in-training program for youth joining staff.
COPE and climbing run out of the Challenge Valley area.
TNT, The New Trail, covering Scout through First Class rank.
A high-adventure track for older Scouts covering climbing, COPE, and whitewater.
An ecology and conservation centre with live specimens and nature displays.
Covered pavilions throughout the program areas.
The Summer Squad provisional unit, with adult leadership provided.
Activity fields for inter-troop and camp-wide games.
A private lake with two separate waterfronts.

versions.summary: Scouts BSA resident summer camp set in the mountains of Northeast Georgia.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
